hooks.commandWindows: $c = @(); try { $e = & git --exec-path 2>$null; if ($e) { $c += Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $e)) } } catch {}; $g = (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if ($g) { $d = Split-Path $g; $c += Split-Path $d; $c += Split-Path (Split-Path $d) }; $c += Join-Path "$env:ProgramFiles" 'Git'; $c += Join-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA" 'Programs\Git'; $b = $c | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'bin\bash.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $b) { exit 0 }; $env:AIOS_MOTEUR = 'codex'; & $b "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/garde.sh"; exit $LASTEXITCODE
